statement.excerpt: I literally don’t see any plausible scenario in which either nation outright “wins” the generative AI race to the exclusion of the other.
statement.document_title: The core misconception that is driving American AI policy

from_speaker: to the exclusion of the other
our_interpretation: Read in context, this predicts that neither country's providers will eliminate the other country's participation in supplying generative AI.
Exclusion includes loss of the ability to serve domestic customers. A benchmark lead, greater market share, or exclusion from individual foreign markets is insufficient.
The statement supplies no deadline. Continued coexistence can corroborate it but cannot establish the indefinite forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Both countries continue supplying generative AI throughout the claimed horizon. Because that horizon is unlimited, finite observations cannot conclusively establish support.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A dated event establishes that one country has achieved exclusive dominance and eliminated the other country's providers from supplying generative AI, including their domestic market.
